up: List all distinct target descriptions (i.e., the preferred name of the target from the target dictionary) for assays where the assay organism is 'Caenorhabditis elegans' and for which at least one activity measurement exists. Only include targets that are associated with such assays.
sql:
SELECT DISTINCT td.pref_name AS target_description
FROM assays ass
INNER JOIN target_dictionary td ON ass.tid = td.tid
INNER JOIN activities act ON ass.assay_id = act.assay_id
WHERE ass.assay_organism = 'Caenorhabditis elegans';
